The MongolZ is a Mongolian esports organization founded in 2013. They became the first Asian team to reach #1 in both the HLTV World Rankings and the Valve Regional Standings.

They won Esports World Cup 2025 and became the first Asian team to reach a Major Grand Final, achieving this with the youngest average player age ever recorded in a Major final.
